Plasma Blast

Released August 14, 2013 · 105 cards

Expanded

Plasma Blast is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on August 14, 2013. Its main set has 101 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (105 in total). It includes 85 Pokémon, 19 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

26 illustrators worked on Plasma Blast. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (29), Kouki Saitou (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Akira Komayama (5), Masakazu Fukuda (5), Naoki Saito (5), Eske Yoshinob (4), Kagemaru Himeno (4).
